note: Industrial-zone pipe gantry and checkpoint barriers (set-piece-districts.md): a 3x1 overhead pipe rack cut per cell, the gantry column, a jersey barrier, a bollard, and a boom gate's post and arm. Measured 1536x1024 RGBA; interiors are alpha 253, not 255. Geometry-first reskin of templates/industrial-street-kit-guide.png (street-dressing-guide.py), 300 px per world cell; every rect is the guide frame and the raw came back at the guide's own size. The pipe strip is one alpha piece: it is cut at the guide's cell boundaries, which run through the flange collars, so a straight cell repeats with the joint on its edge. Pipes run east-west; the beam cell's I-beam runs north-south. Pipe cells carry no cover and draw in the roof pass through street-dressing-motions.tileset.json; the column stands under a beam cell. The boom arm is an overlay a figure walks under (no cover), its root at the west edge against the post's pivot on the post's east side. Exact prompt in industrial-street-kit.prompt.txt.
